---
title: "Still at Home"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)

# Read in downloaded Census data
sarasota <- read_rds("sarasota.rds")

# Filter for 18-34 year olds and calculate the percentage living at home
young_adults <- sarasota |>
  filter(variable %in% c("B09021_008", "B09021_012")) |>
  select(GEOID, NAME, variable, estimate) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate) |>
  rename(total_18_34 = B09021_008, living_at_home = B09021_012) |>
  mutate(pct_at_home = 100 * (living_at_home / total_18_34))

# Calculate the median percentage across tracts
median_val <- median(young_adults$pct_at_home, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot
#| warning: false

young_adults |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pct_at_home)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, color = "white", fill = "#1d3557") +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = median_val,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "#e63946",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Young Adults (18–34) Living at Home in Sarasota County",
    subtitle = paste0("Red dashed line indicates county median (", round(median_val, 1), "%)"),
    x = "Percentage living with parents (%)",
    y = "Number of tracts",
    caption = "Source: US Census Bureau 2018–2022 ACS"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```
